scope: Visual and engineering precheck for a review-only accessory Template. This record is not an art approval or user approval.

recipeSet.hashInput: JSON.stringify(recipes sorted by id, each represented as [id, selections sorted by option-field key])

reviewed: 60 declared recipes rendered and exported in Chromium
14 option choices traversed through direct single-field UI changes
dark and light composites for chef toque, black opaque sunglasses, and cyan cyber glasses with base and clothing variants

findings: The chef toque base aligns with the orb crown and remains above the eye field.
Black sunglasses now cover both open-eye marks completely; closed-eye use is explicitly blocked.
Translucent cyber lenses preserve eye visibility while containing both eye marks within their lens area.
The accessories remain separate transparent foreground layers; all new compositions remain pending parent and user review.
